newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka to invite tenders for oil storage tanks.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka to invite tenders for oil storage tanks.

text.p: Sri Lanka will invite tenders this month for the rebuilding of oil storage tanks damaged in attacks last year by Tamil Tiger rebels, the head of the state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) said on Friday.
"We will float tender documents later this month calling for tenders to rebuild the damaged oil tanks," CPC chairman Anil Obeysekera told Reuters. The tender dates have not been set.

The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Tiger (LTTE) rebels, who have been fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils for 13 years, attacked and damaged two CPC oil storage depots in a Colombo suburb in October 1995.
"We haven't even yet made public tender documents, decided on the definite date when they will be floated, or the closing date for tenders," Obeysekera said.
He said the decision on the tender winner will probably be made in the first quarter of 1997.
